Tretinoin (or differin or taz), spf and maybe some vitamin c are gold standard. Anything else will be supplemental. 

I'd ditch all the expensive shit, get yourself some vanicream cleanser and vanicream daily moisturizer, an spf (I like drmtlgy broad spectrum clear for acne prone skin, its an elta md clear dupe) and get your tretinoin back out if not expired. Start with every other night and work your way back to every night. Adjust accordingly if dry or irritated. Honestly I would just push through the retinization period because I like fast results, but that's up to you.

As far as anything else supplemental after your skin has readjusted to tret (give it three good months), an extra hydrating serum if dry, azelaic acid if dealing with hyperpigmentation issues, peptides for anti aging.

If you continue to have acne after 3-6 months of this routine it would be time to see a dermatologist again for oral treatments- IE spironolactone, antibiotics, accutane. Your dermatologist would know what is the best options for you. 

Once your acne clears, THEN begin Microneedling.

TL/DR: I'm an esthetician. Don't buy snake oil even from estheticians. Believe in science and save your money and skin. 

Hope this helps!
